question: Who is the author of 'Harshacharita'?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Banabhatta__.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banabhatta**

 
 
• **Banabhatta** one of the most accomplished writers in sanskrit prose best known for his chronicle, the** Harshacharita.**
 
• **Banabhatta** was **Sanskrit writer of India who was as harshavardhana's court poet.**
 
• The biography of H**arshvardhana** that he penned is known as the** ''Harshacharita**.**''Banabhatta's **first historial work is** the Harshacharita.**
 
• He served as **the Asthana Kavi** at **the court of King Harsha Vardhana,** who ruled in **north India **from **Sthanvishvara** and later from **Kannauj from 606 and 647 CE.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalhana**:

 
 
• **Known for *Rajatarangini*, w**hich chronicles the history of Kashmir.
 
• He is often considered the father of Indian historiography.
 
• First known historian of India; wrote a comprehensive historical chronicle of Kashmir.
 
 
 
• **Pāṇini**:
 
 
• Revolutionized linguistics with his work *Aṣṭādhyāyī*, which systematized Sanskrit grammar through concise sutras.
 
 
 
• **Kalidasa**:
 
 
• Revered as one of the greatest poets and playwrights in Indian literature.
 
• His works, such as *Abhijñānaśākuntalam*, are renowned for their poetic beauty and emotional depth.
